data.one_liner: Automatically persists and restores bloc and cubit states.
data.what_it_does: Extends the bloc state management library to automatically save states to local storage and restore them upon application restart. It provides built-in persistence using Hive CE with custom serialization via toJson and fromJson methods.
use_when: You are using the bloc state management library and need to persist user sessions or application state across app restarts
You want automatic caching of bloc and cubit states without writing manual storage boilerplate
avoid_when: You are managing state using a framework other than bloc or cubit
You require highly complex relational database queries where a key-value store is insufficient
strengths: Seamless integration with package:bloc and package:flutter_bloc
Platform-agnostic and performant storage layer built on Hive CE, supporting web and native platforms
Customizable storage directories, prefixes, and per-instance storage overrides
weaknesses: Requires manual implementation of toJson and fromJson for every persisted bloc or cubit
Relies entirely on the bloc architecture ecosystem
data.setup_notes: Initialize HydratedBloc.storage with HydratedStorage.build during app startup before calling runApp.
